name: Domino Golf
description: Domino Golf is a western domino game played on a larger set where players use standard matching placements while trying to optimize scoring outcomes over multiple hands, analogous to minimizing a golf score.

overview.description: Domino Golf is a western domino game played on a larger set where players use standard matching placements while trying to optimize scoring outcomes over multiple hands, analogous to minimizing a golf score.

history.origins: The game is encountered as a modern scoring-focused domino format that uses the larger tile set to support longer and more varied hand outcomes.
timeline: Modern era: circulated through social play and rules collections.
history.cultural: Played as a social match format where consistent low-risk play can outperform high-variance lines.
history.evolution: Golf-style framing emphasizes cumulative scoring discipline more than single-hand wins.

setup.dealing: Deal tiles by player count; remaining tiles may form a boneyard by table profile.
setup.equipment: Domino set and score tracking for golf-style match play.

rules.objective: Finish the match with the best golf-style cumulative score under the table rules while playing legally by matching ends.
rules.gameplay: Players place legal matching tiles to open ends. When blocked, the active profile determines whether to draw from a boneyard or pass. Hands are scored according to the golf-style match policy, and the match ends after an agreed number of hands or score threshold.
keyRules: Tiles must match legal open ends.
Blocked turns resolve via the draw-or-pass table profile.
Scoring is applied per hand under a golf-style cumulative policy.

strategy.basic: Avoid being left with high-pip tiles at hand end.
strategy.intermediate: Preserve flexibility so you can always respond to common end values.
strategy.advanced: Control end values to reduce opponent mobility while keeping your own safe exits.
tips: In a cumulative match, minimizing disasters is often stronger than chasing perfect hands.
Save flexible connectors for late-hand safety.

synthesis.shortDescription: Domino Golf is a double-12 domino match format framed around cumulative scoring discipline while using standard connecting play.
